status.micPopupText:
The microphone could not be started because it is either in use by another application or the permissions have not been granted.

Try the following steps:

1. Close any open application or browser tabs that might be using the microphone, then click Retry.

2. Restart your device and try again.

3. Ensure the application has the necessary permission to access your microphone.

If the issue persists, click Close Application to contact Technical Support.
status.cameraPopupText:
The camera could not be started because it is either:

  • Already in use by another application, or
  • Lacking the required permissions.

Try the following steps:

1. Close any open apps or browser tabs that might be using the camera, then click Retry.

2. Restart your device and try again.

3. Check permissions to ensure the application has access to your camera.

If the issue continues, click Close Application and contact Technical Support for further assistance.

cameraSetup.instructionSubTitle: System will guide the   camera setup process
cameraSetup.instructionStep:
1. You will need to set up three cameras for this proctored session.

2. Please ensure all required devices are arranged before starting.

3. Each camera must support HD quality (720p or higher) for clear visibility.

4. You may use webcams, mobile phones, or external cameras as needed.

5. At each step, you’ll be able to select the camera from a dropdown list.

6. If you choose a mobile phone, you will be prompted to scan a QR code to connect it.

7.Real-time instructions will guide you through proper camera placement and positioning.
cameraSetup.customInstructionStep:
1. You will need to set up a camera for the proctored session.

2.Arrange the camera before starting.

3. Ensure the camera should have HD quality (720p or higher) for clear visibility.

4. You can use webcams, mobile phones, or other external devices.

5. At each step, you can choose which camera to use from the dropdown list.

6. If you select a mobile phone, you will need to scan a QR code to connect it.

7. Real-time instructions will guide you on camera positioning during the process.
